selectionMetric: paired daily net PnL improvement with unchanged risk, drawdown and tail-loss constraints
entryPolicy: existing configured canonical equity/ETF and closed-daily crypto breakout; same causal entry cohorts for exit comparison
barExecution: estimated, conservative stop-first when OHLC order is ambiguous; next observable bar execution, spread and slippage explicit; no observed bid/ask inferred from OHLCV
corporateActions: fetch official splits; exclude unsupported split-crossing paths symmetrically and report exclusions; never treat a split as a trading return
stress: double modeled costs, adverse intrabar ambiguity, delayed observations and partial fills
promotion: bar-based winner is research-only; no automatic production promotion or claims of real account returns
stopRule: one registered comparison; retain baseline if no robust winner; no retuning on test or holdout
scope: coverage and data limitations must be reported per asset; no invented option history or quote paths
